text: Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
And He is with you wherever you are.
So remember Me; I will remember you.
Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear.
Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
The most beloved deeds to Allah are those done consistently, even if small.
Make things easy and do not make them difficult.
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.
The strong person is not the one who wrestles others. The strong person is the one who controls himself when angry.
Your journey is personal. Progress, not perfection, is what matters.
Each prayer is a new chance to return to peace.
Small acts of goodness, done sincerely, transform the heart.
Be gentle with yourself today. Allah is Ar-Rahman.
And seek help through patience and prayer.
Do not lose hope in the mercy of Allah.
Smiling at your brother is charity.
The best of you are those who are best to their families.
Consistency in worship is a form of self-care for the soul.
You are exactly where you need to be to take the next small step.
My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
